### Changes

**[LogIn.tsx](file:///home/gaitano/01-studio/01-src/topbox/frontend/src/components/LogIn/LogIn.tsx)**
- After successful `/api/auth/login` response, calls `setAuthSession({ accessToken, refreshToken, username })` — tokens now persisted to `localStorage` before navigating.

**[App.tsx](file:///home/gaitano/01-studio/01-src/topbox/frontend/src/App.tsx)**
- Added `ProtectedRoute` component — checks `getAccessToken()` from `localStorage`, redirects to `/login` (preserving `location.state.from`) if absent. `/dashboard` is now wrapped with it.

### Auth flow now

```
Signup → auto-login → setAuthSession → /dashboard ✅
Login  → setAuthSession → /dashboard ✅
/dashboard without token → redirect /login ✅
```
